name: Build and release binaries

on:
  release:
    types: [ created ]

jobs:
  releases-matrix:
    name: Build and release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        goos: [ linux, windows, darwin ]
        goarch: [ amd64, arm64 ]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

    - name: Build assets
      uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
      with:
        node-version: 26
        cache: 'npm'
    - run: echo "Building assets for ${{ github.ref_name }}"
    - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
    - run: npm run build

    - name: Compile templates
      uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      with:
        go-version-file: 'go.mod'
        cache: false
    - uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cache/go-build
          ~/go
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-go-

    - name: Build and upload binaries
      uses: wangyoucao577/go-release-action@2aa2977ad6a4534f9179e22bd0ff146a1e1d3466 # v1.52
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        goos: ${{ matrix.goos }}
        goarch: ${{ matrix.goarch }}
        goversion: go.mod
        binary_name: portkey
        pre_command: export CGO_ENABLED=0
        asset_name: "portkey-${{ matrix.goos }}-${{ matrix.goarch }}"
        extra_files: LICENSE.txt README.md
        md5sum: false
        overwrite: true
        build_command: sh build.sh -v "${{ github.ref_name }}"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
